name: ZIGGURAT WHAT IT TAKES
notes: Ishtar Gate/1987 flop, Marduk vs Tiamat, Shamash on the Hammurabi stele with rod and ring, Pazuzu amulets and The Exorcist — all accurate, excellent ramp.

name: OM IS WHERE THE HEART IS
notes: Ganesha, Nataraja on the dwarf of ignorance, Kali halting on Shiva, Saraswati's veena, Indra slaying Vritra — all standard and correct.

name: URUK & ROLL
notes: Enkidu, Nineveh/Ashurbanipal, Utnapishtim, Humbaba, Siduri all verified; deep but the ladder genuinely climbs and every row is from the epic itself.

name: RAMA KNOWS BEST
notes: Hanuman, Ravana, Valmiki ('tradition credits' properly hedged), Ayodhya, Kaikeyi's two boons — all correct; no leaks into n1-myth after that file's fix.

name: MYTHTERPIECE THEATER
notes: Botticelli, Bernini's Borghese Daphne, Goya's Saturn, Titian's cheetah-drawn Bacchus for the Duke of Ferrara, Velazquez's Las Hilanderas — all check out.

name: WRITTEN IN THE STARS
notes: Was 43: Ursa Major sat at $1600 above the harder Cassiopeia and 'large constellation' translated the answer; swapped rows 3/4 and dropped 'large'.

name: UNDERWORLD WIDE WEB
notes: Tartarus, Duat, Yomi, Mictlan, Tuonela all accurate; loses a repeat point for sitting beside a second afterlife category in the same file.

name: AFTERLIFE OF THE PARTY
notes: Charon, Cerberus' honey cake, Yama, Baron Samedi, Ereshkigal/Nergal verified; thematic twin of UNDERWORLD WIDE WEB but answers are disjoint.

name: TRICKSTER TREAT
notes: Was 43: the standard Ashanti telling prices the stories at four captures (Mmoatia included), so 'bought them with hornets, a python and a leopard' overstated; hedged to 'a price that included'.

name: PRANKS FOR THE MEMORIES
notes: Br'er Rabbit, Coyote, infant Hermes, Reynard displacing 'goupil', Till Eulenspiegel/Strauss all correct; second trickster category in the file costs a repeat point.

name: HALO, IT'S ME
notes: Patrick, Nicholas of Myra, George, Jerome's lion, Denis the cephalophore — all legends correctly flagged as legend; clean climb.

name: LEGEND HAS IT
notes: Godiva, Tell, Pied Piper 1284, El Cid's corpse ride ('legend straps'), Prester John — hedging is right and the ladder is honest.
